title: SharedArrayBuffer Lock-Free Counter with Atomics
description: Observe how Atomics.add and Atomics.wait/notify coordinate two workers sharing one memory page.

steps.label: 1. Allocate Shared Backing Store
steps.description: Main thread creates a 4-byte SharedArrayBuffer and shares the reference (no copy, no detach) with Worker A.
steps.codeHighlight: const sab = new SharedArrayBuffer(4); const view = new Int32Array(sab);

steps.label: 2. Atomic Increment on Main
steps.description: Atomics.add(view, 0, 1) issues a hardware-locked read-modify-write instruction, preventing torn writes.

steps.label: 3. Atomics.notify Wakes Worker
steps.description: Atomics.notify(view, 0, 1) wakes one parked thread on the futex queue to read the updated slot.
